seo.metaTitle: Image to PDF converter — 100% Private In-Browser Utility | PrivacyFold
seo.metaDescription: Place one or more photos or scanned receipts onto a standard US Letter or A4 page with clean margins for instant printing or portal upload. Runs 100% locally in your browser via /wasm/pdf/image-to-pdf-v1.wasm with zero file uploads.
seo.aeoSummary: Image to PDF converter processes files and text entirely inside your browser tab using /wasm/pdf/image-to-pdf-v1.wasm (Tier D). Zero bytes are uploaded to any server.

faqs.question: Does Image to PDF converter upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.answer: No. Image to PDF converter executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using /wasm/pdf/image-to-pdf-v1.wasm. No data leaves your device.
faqs.q: Does Image to PDF converter upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.a: No. Image to PDF converter executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using /wasm/pdf/image-to-pdf-v1.wasm. No data leaves your device.

faqs.question: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate Image to PDF converter?
faqs.answer: Yes. Use Lane A schema /schemas/image_to_pdf.json or open /tools/image-to-pdf?mode=agent#payload with input[data-pf='input'] and window.__PRIVACYFOLD_RESULT__.
